اقتتلتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَتَلْتُمَا (iqtataltumā) /iq.ta.tal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اُقْتُتِلْتُمَا (uqtutiltumā) /uq.tu.til.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
